The [[Mistlock Observatory]] is the [[City#Lobby|lobby]] and the entrance to the [[Fractals of the Mists]] dungeon, where players can access fractal [[service]]s and [[vendor]]s, as well as test some of the [[Fractals of the Mists#Mechanics|fractal mechanics]]. This set of floating islands serves as the laboratory for the [[asura]]n scientist [[Dessa]] and her work group, who research fragments of reality found in [[the Mists]].

== Getting there ==
* Passing through the central portal at the [[Mist Portals]] in [[Fort Marriner]], Lion's Arch, and selecting "Enter" on the screen that pops up.
* Using the portal in the east of [[Mistlock Sanctuary]].

== History ==
Initially, access to the Mistlock Observatory came from a [[Consortium]]-owned [[asura gate]]. This gate was intended to lead to the [[Pearl Islet]] on [[Southsun Cove]], but for unknown reasons it went haywire and instead led to the Dessa's lab. She does not know it, and denies any potential connection to both the Consortium and [[Lion's Arch]]. 

Dessa claims to have made the laboratory to study [[the Mists]] and its ability to create the Fractals, but hostile forces prevent her and her [[krewe]] from properly studying the nature of the fractals. As such, she asks adventurers (or "hired help") to clear out the Fractals of hostiles (which she dubs instabilities) so that her krewe can traverse safely.

The Mistlock Observatory itself seems to be a fractal as well, as [[Fractals of the Mists (story)|when Dessa tried to leave]] the entire observatory had 'reset' similar to the Fractals. The area is based on a set islands floating in the Mists, featuring architectural elements of the [[Asura]]n and [[Ascalon]]ian design. 

{{spoilers|After the final battle in the [[Shattered Observatory Fractal]], it was revealed that the whole Mistlock Observatory is indeed just another fractal, and Dessa and her krewes are merely "simulations" as every other things the players meet in the fractals. The researchers inside are locked inside the fractals in the same manner as all the other creatures in the "unstable" fractals are locked in a time loop.
|the ''[[Shattered Observatory Fractal]]''}}

== Trivia ==
* The portal to Mistlock Observatory was moved from [[Claw Island Portage]] to [[Fort Marriner]], and the portal color was changed from purple to red after rebuilding [[Lion's Arch]].
* [[MAST-ER604]] was previously used to transport players to other islands in the observatory, but this function is now fulfilled by the use of teleporters.
* As of the release of ''[[Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns|Heart of Thorns]]'', the vendor NPCs within the Mistlock Observatory share models with bosses from the [[Uncategorized Fractal]]:
** [[BUY-2046 PFR]] shares [[Baron von Scrufflebutt]]'s model.
** [[BUY-4373]] shares [[Professor Mew]]'s model.
** [[INFUZ-5959]] shares [[Snuggles]]' model.
** [[MRC-6478]] shares [[Mr. Mittens]]' model.

[[Kelvei, the Legendary Observer]] is an [[Asura]] NPC found in the [[Mistlock Observatory]]. Speaking with Kelvei will give you [[Theory of the Finite Result]], which is necessary to unlock the [[Legendary Backpacks|Ad Infinitum I: Finite Result]] [[achievement]].

After using the Theory of the Finite Result, Kelvei will offer advice on how to complete various parts of the achievement left unfinished.

{{Quotation|[[Mistlock Sanctuary Passkey|Official description]]|The Mistlock Sanctuary, a place that exists simultaneously in both Tyria and the Mists.}}
[[Mistlock Sanctuary]] is a [[lounge]] accessible by using [[Mistlock Sanctuary Passkey]], unique among other lounges for having a [[Fractals of the Mists]] entrance portal and Fractal vendors. It features most of the standard [[service]]s and [[crafting station]]s, and, alongside [[Armistice Bastion]] and [[Thousand Seas Pavilion]], is of the few lounges that exist within their own unique [[instance]]. Other notable features include a [[Nova Launch (Mistlock Sanctuary)|fast travel special action skill]], lowered gravity, and a hidden [[#Minigame|minigame]].

A collection of rocky scraps of land floating in a low-gravity void, Mistlock Sanctuary is a safe haven within [[the Mists]] for Mistwalkers and Fractals of the Mists explorers that seems to have been colonized by [[asura]] similar to [[Dessa's Krewe]]. Perhaps due to the unstable release of magic following the deaths of two [[Elder Dragon]]s, it has established a foothold in [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]], allowing visitors to easily come and go. 

== Getting there ==
Access requires one of the two types of Mistlock Sanctuary Passkey:
* {{item icon|Mistlock Sanctuary Passkey}} — {{gem|1000}} from the [[Gem Store]].
* {{item icon|Mistlock Sanctuary Passkey (2 weeks)}} — {{gem|150}} from the [[Gem Store]].

== Mechanics ==
=== General ===
* It is not possible to park characters in the Mistlock Sanctuary and then transfer the pass to other characters via the [[bank]]. Upon logging back onto the character without a pass, they will be expelled from the map.
** Placing the permanent pass into a [[Shared Inventory Slot]] will allow all characters simultaneous access to the Sanctuary.
* It is possible to waypoint out of the Sanctuary by navigating to the lower layers of the [[world map]].
* Selecting "Return to my previous map" from the central portal will teleport you to your exact previous location; for example, the end of a jumping puzzle you were at. The same is true when using the pass again.
** This fails if the character has gone to its home instance using the [[Home Portal Stone]], or to their Guild Hall, and then returned to the Mistlock Sanctuary.
* The map doesn't have the [[day and night]] cycle and it is constantly 11:00 noon of Tyrian time.
* Players inside the lounge will show up on the world map as being on the island directly below [[Claw Island]].
* Most of the chairs cannot be used in this lounge.

=== Physics ===
* Players will be affected by {{effect|Cosmic Energy}} while in this map, allowing them to jump higher. They will also have access to the [[special action skill]] {{skill icon|Nova Launch (Mistlock Sanctuary)}}.
* Gliders will rise upwards. There is an invisible ceiling to prevent them from rising too high. Gliders that are already above the ceiling will descend to it.
* There is an invisible "floor" beneath "street" level of the islands but above their lowest level; players who fall off the edge will bounce up and down for a while until they find the "resting" level, and can move (float) around normally. "Jumping" while floating like this will launch the player into the air by activating the player's glider.
{{bug|
* It is very easy to get trapped inside terrain when using [[Nova Launch (Mistlock Sanctuary)|Nova Launch]], requiring a respawn at a waypoint.
* You can fall off the edge and hit the bottom of the map using the [[Endless Boss Chest Tonic]] or [[Endless Shiny Chest Tonic]].}}

=== Minigame ===
[[File:Mistlock Sanctuary game start panel.jpg|200px|thumb|The panel which begins the bouncing ball game.]]
Players may interact with the control panel at the base of the tree in the northeast corner to spawn a [[Globolla Marble]], similar to those found during [[Viirastra]]'s encounter in the [[Shattered Observatory Fractal|Shattered Observatory]]. Successfully bouncing the marble back to its tree (by ensuring a player is present at each bounce) will cause it to become stationary and begin glowing; interacting with it at this point will result in the following:
* The player is turned into a fiery orb and granted the effect {{effect|You are a being of pure light and energy.}}, allowing them to float in midair.
* Skills are replaced with {{skill icon|Increase Gravity}} and {{skill icon|Decrease Gravity}}, which can be used to adjust how high you float, and the special action skill is changed to {{skill icon|Nova Dash}}.
